### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 58be6770ab176bbca37fc2948113172b70c83e3c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

**Patch round** at 2026-11-27T22:50Z, head `4c965f4a5e`. This answers the Test UI red at `19f3e118f2` (`createBody.seedPlaceholders-12810.test.ts`, 2 failures).

**Cause.** The `knowledge_source` create seed placed its object binding and its content list inside `source` (`source.object: 'example_object'`, `source.content: ['example_field']`). The Studio create flow (`buildCreateModeBody` / `seedPlaceholderKeys` in app-shell's `createBody.ts`) removes placeholder identity at the top level only. It would have carried both placeholders into a new source as structural defaults, which is the defect objectui#12810 closed. No schema-valid seed can avoid this: `source.object` and a non-empty `content` (ADR-0161 K5) are required, and both are nested.

**Fix: the seed is withdrawn, not the expectation.** `metadata-create-seeds.ts` is byte-identical to `main` again. `knowledge_source` is back on `KNOWN_UNSEEDED`, now with this reason: a seed waits until the Studio form (row 5) builds `source` from the author's input. The card allowed this option ("or the type stays on `KNOWN_UNSEEDED` with the reason"). The UI test file is not edited; its 14-type table describes the seeds again. The MCP contract case now asserts that no `createSeed` is served for `knowledge_source`, and keeps its other checks: the content rule in the served schema, a hand-written source with one object and one field saving as a draft, and `['*']`, `id` and `contentFields` each refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the prescription. The changeset drops its `@objectstack/spec` entry; only a test file changed under `packages/spec`.

**PR body is now stale** in the paragraphs on the `metadata-create-seeds.ts` seed, the seed in the MCP case, and the `@objectstack/spec` changeset line. Editing it is the seat's job, per os-dev rule 3.

**Readings at `4c965f4a5e`.** Unlocked gates, each exit 0: `check-skills-token-ratchet` (6639/6639), `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`. overlap-check: `VERDICT overlap exit 1`, the same #36158-against-main conflict in the ratchet file reported before; `origin/main`, #38032 and #38013 merge cleanly. NOT MEASURED: the app-shell test, the spec create-seeds test and the rewritten MCP case. Three queue rounds under slot `o1C-37310-v3` sat at position 4-5 behind a dogfood run holding over 23 minutes, and the lock was never acquired. The app-shell and create-seeds inputs equal `main`'s (`git diff --quiet 8d34c4404f HEAD -- packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-create-seeds.ts`), so CI's Test UI and Test Core on this head are the evidence.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4c965f4a5edef925ba65f597c8d5e6c3bb974ae8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Read: card #37310 (body and all six comments), PR #38053 (body, file list, both comments), the net diff against merge base `8d34c4404f` (six files), and the 73 check-runs on the head. `origin/main` is four commits past the merge base and none of them touches the skill, the ratchet script, `packages/spec/src/ai` or `packages/services/service-knowledge`, so the merge-base reading is the reading on `main`. `Security-touching` is `yes` because the changed hunks teach a permission (`manage_knowledge_sources` beside `manage_metadata`), the save-time admission, embedding as egress, and that credential-class and `internal` fields are never indexed. No security weakness was found in the change.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged. Right.** No file under `packages/spec/src` other than a test comment is in the diff. `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-create-seeds.ts` is byte-identical to the merge base (verified with `git diff --quiet`), and `knowledge_source` is still in the test's `KNOWN_UNSEEDED` set, now with a reason. The card allowed this option in item 3.
- **Published surface: `@objectstack/skills` only. Right.** The SKILL.md section and the eval file ship in the skills package. The MCP test case and the spec test comment publish nothing. The ratchet script is repo tooling.
- **Gate verdicts: green.** 73 check-runs, 60 `success`, 13 `skipped` (opt-in, queue, schedule, docs-build and path-filtered rows), none failed or pending. `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` and `Spec property liveness` are all `success`. The dev's NOT MEASURED items (the rewritten MCP case, `check:skill-examples`) are therefore answered by CI on this head.
- **Token ratchet 6609 to 6639: right, and justified by the record it cites.** The gate's own header names one recognised raise path: deletion of restatement in the same file shown in the diff, plus the standing ruling quoted in the PR body (the 2026-10-27 words or record 6513306068), moves the row by the measured remainder, pinned at the measurement. All three hold on this head. The diff deletes the wiring paragraph's package list, the Hygiene column, the example's four comments, the example's `refresh` line and the split passage's adapter aside. The PR body quotes the ruling verbatim and untranslated with the record id and letter B. The arithmetic reproduces: the file is 26581 bytes at the head and 26462 at the merge base; less the 27-byte stamp line that is 26554 priced bytes, and ceil(26554 / 4) is 6639, so the row sits at the measurement with headroom 0.
- **Card item 3 premise correction: right.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-type-schema.ts` carries the #17502 note: the served JSON Schema publishes what an author may write, so a `retiredKey()` node is dropped. The served contract cannot carry a tombstone's prescription; it reaches an MCP author through the save refusal. The new MCP case asserts both halves.
- **Acceptance grep: clears.** Every hit of `contentFields` or `'*'` under `skills/objectstack-ai` names the key as retired or refused, or is a `must_not_contain` token the card itself asked for. `adapter: 'ragflow'` has no hit.

### ② Semver level

`'@objectstack/skills': patch` matches what the diff publishes: skill text and an eval fixture, no spec, runtime or CLI code. The changeset body carries both declaration lines and they equal the PR body's.

Clause-②: no. Right: the diff narrows nothing an author could write; the refusals the skill now names landed with #37304 and #37306 and their own changesets.
Metadata-protocol: none. Right: no conversion, no retired key and no schema edit is in this diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty** in the dev report (7228977107). Nothing to answer.
- **Dev flag, create seed withdrawn (7229668414): accepted.** The reason holds against the schema: `source.object` and a non-empty `source.content` are required and nested, so any schema-valid seed carries a placeholder object and a placeholder field below the top level.
- **Dev flag, the amendment part left out: accepted as a declared partial, with one condition, escalated to the seat.** Amendments 7221575164 and 7224082428 add two acceptance lines to the card (the section names the five #37971 rule ids; the example passes `os validate` with zero knowledge-source findings). #37971 is not on `main` (`packages/lint/src/validate-knowledge-source.ts` does not exist there), so the card's own "Blocked-by #37971 for this part only" applies and the omission is correct for this head. But the PR body's first line is `Fixes #37310`. Landing THIS head under that keyword closes a card whose amended acceptance is unmet. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` gives the form for a merge that should not close the card: `Part of #37310`, naming the half that is left. So either the head that lands is the later one that carries the amendment text (then `Fixes` is right and this head never lands), or this head lands and the line must read `Part of #37310`. The PR body says the PR stays draft until #37971 lands, which is the first option. This record covers this head only and does not license landing it under `Fixes`.
- **PR title is stale, for the seat.** It still ends "knowledge_source gets a create seed"; the seed was withdrawn. The title becomes the squash subject. The body's Verification item 2 also points at `metadata-create-seeds.ts` for the `KNOWN_UNSEEDED` reason, which lives in `metadata-create-seeds.test.ts`.
- **Out-of-scope note, not filed.** `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` line 137 says the `knowledge` capability is mounted "on `requires`" and does not mention a shipped item. It is outside this diff and still true as far as it goes.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.

### ④ Design judgment

Every sentence of the rewritten section was read against `packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts`, `packages/services/service-knowledge/src` (`knowledge-source-registry.ts`, `knowledge-source-admission.ts`, `knowledge-tools.ts`), `packages/metadata-core/src/knowledge-source-save-admission.ts`, `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts`, `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`, the three store plugins, and `content/docs` on the merge base.

**skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md**

What holds, checked key by key: `name` (the address-grammar pattern), `label` and `description`, `adapter` optional with the three-step resolution and the refusal naming the registered stores, `source.kind` with one value, `source.object`, `source.content` (non-empty, no empty member, `'*'` refused by a pattern, credential-class and `internal` fields never indexed), `metadataFields`, `where`, `split` with `strategy` required once written and `recursive` when omitted, `refresh.onRecordChange` default `true`, `aiExposed` default `true`. All seven retired keys and arms match their tombstones and prescriptions, including "listing the fields a `'*'` stood for" and "edit a registration in code by hand". `manage_knowledge_sources` beside `manage_metadata` matches `meta-item-read-gate.ts` and the schema note. `topK` is a `search_knowledge` argument. The checked example parses. No refusal code is newly taught in the section, so none is wrong.

M1 (must-fix) — "An item mounts the knowledge service and its store with no `requires: ['knowledge']`" is false for one of the two doors the same paragraph names. Only an item the STACK SHIPS mounts the service: `stackItemCapabilities` reads the stack's `knowledgeSources` collection at boot (`packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts`), and nothing reads published run-time items when capabilities are composed. `main`'s own pages say so: `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` line 17, "the token is for an app that ships none and authors its sources at run time", and `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`, "A deployment that holds a `knowledge_source` item but mounts no knowledge service says so once at boot ... nothing loads, indexes or searches them ... Such an item is one the stack does not ship — saved at run time". The sentence sits directly after "or author it in Studio or over MCP", and the card's reader is the author who builds over the MCP draft door. An agent that follows the skill in an app that ships no source saves an item that is never indexed, with no `search_knowledge` tool and no refusal: `knowledge-source-save-admission.ts` judges nothing where no knowledge service is registered, so the next sentence of the skill (the save is refused when you may not search the object) is silent there too. This is the authoring trap Prime Directive 10 names. Fix: say that a SHIPPED item mounts the service, and that an app shipping none and authoring at run time lists `requires: ['knowledge']`. The changeset body repeats the sentence and takes the same fix.

S1 (should-fix) — the `name` row and "one name is one source" teach the pre-addendum identity. On `main` a source's slot is `(package, name)` (`knowledge-source-registry.ts`, "Two packages' sources of one name are two sources, and so are a package's source and a package-less one"; ADR-0150 addendum of 2026-11-25), and `search_knowledge` lists and takes a source's FACE: `NAMESPACE-NAME` for a package's source, the bare name only for a package-less one (`knowledge-tools.ts`). The skill's first door is "Ship it in a package", and for exactly that door "what `search_knowledge` lists" is not the bare `name`. A bare name still resolves in `sourceIds` while it is unambiguous, which is why this is not a must-fix. Fix: the row says a package's source is listed as `NAMESPACE-NAME`, and the second-door sentence says a registration in code and an environment item of one name are refused as a pair, not that a name is globally one source.

S2 (should-fix) — "rerank and hybrid weights are options of the store's plugin" names options no shipped store has. `KnowledgePgvectorPluginOptions` is `id`, `url`, `schema`, `poolMax`, `connectTimeoutMs`, `queryPrefix`, `embedder`, `env`; a search of the `src` trees of `knowledge-pgvector`, `knowledge-turso` and `knowledge-memory` finds no rerank and no hybrid-weight option outside tests. ADR-0161 K8 item 4 draws a boundary (such settings would live in an adapter's plugin options, never in the contract or a source); the sentence the PR replaced was a boundary statement too ("belong to the adapter or application code"). The new wording states existence, and an author will go looking for the option (Prime Directive 10, declared is not delivered). Fix: keep it a boundary ("belong to the store's plugin, never a source") or add that the shipped stores expose neither.

Nits:
- N1 — the egress paragraph says the first build "keeps the text in an index" of "every listed field". The object's display field is also read and kept as each document's `title` whatever `content` lists (`servedFieldsOf`, `recordToDocument`), and the save admission also judges that field and every field `where` reads. "a listed field" understates what is judged; the text sent to the embedder is as stated.
- N2 — the trailing comment on the ratchet row still reads "-18 (was 6824), then -5 A2′ (was 6806)", which describes two earlier moves and not this one. Left as is; the block comment above carries this move.

**skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json**

The file is well formed for the runner (`must_contain_any` is a supported group form, `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/cases.ts`). The three rubrics test the taught facts the card asked for: `name:` and `content:` required, a written `contentFields:` and a written wildcard forbidden, and case 13's reason group (egress, embedding provider, refused, rejected). The reference answers agree with the schema: case 3's "may omit `adapter`: on PostgreSQL the deployment's store is `pgvector`", case 9's `split: { strategy: 'markdown', maxChars: 600 }`, case 13's "refused at parse". The recorded ablation (with-skill pass 3 of 3 on this text, fail 3 of 3 on `main`'s text) meets the card's acceptance line; it is the dev's reading, not re-run here. No must-fix and no should-fix in this file.

Nits:
- N3 — the wildcard tokens `['*'],` and `['*'] }` miss a double-quoted `["*"]` and a single-quoted member followed by a line break. A wrong answer in either spelling passes `must_not_contain`. Likewise `id: 'faq` misses a double-quoted value.
- N4 — case 9 requires `content:` but not `name:`, and does not forbid `id:`, so it does not test the `id` to `name` rename it sits beside.
- N5 — no case exercises the mounting rule of M1 or the permission sentence. Not owed by the card; worth one assertion in the delta that fixes M1.

**scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs** (implementing file)

The row and its comment agree with the gate's contract sentence by sentence: deletion in the same file is shown, the ruling and record are named, the move is the measured remainder and is pinned at the measurement, and the reproduction line in the comment gives 6639. The comment's phrase "the item that mounts the service" inherits M1's wording and should follow its fix. The fixes for M1, S1 and S2 add text, so the row moves again in the delta under the same path.

Not reviewed (lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`): `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-create-seeds.test.ts`, `.changeset/37310-skill-knowledge-source-metadata.md`.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czzx9dtSEm3jWWL9c3`

**L1 verdict (L1-a): REWORK** at head `4c965f4a5edef925ba65f597c8d5e6c3bb974ae8` (card #37310).

## Review summary

**Contract review.** Record 7229853573 is FAIL at the contract tier (`verify-review-tier` PASS). It has one must-fix and two should-fix findings. I adopt it, and I checked M1 against main myself.

**Must fix in the next head:**
- **M1 (must-fix):** the skill says an item mounts the knowledge service and its store with no `requires: ['knowledge']`. That is true only for a source the stack ships in `knowledgeSources`, read at boot. It is false for a source authored at run time through Studio or MCP, the door the same paragraph names. Main's `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx` § Turning it on says the token is for an app that ships none and authors its sources at run time. Teach both cases. Then fix the same wording in the changeset body and in the ratchet row comment.
- **S1 (should-fix):** the `name` row and "one name is one source" teach the old identity. On main a source's slot is `(package, name)`, and `search_knowledge` lists and takes the namespaced spelling for a package's source. A bare name still resolves while it is unambiguous.
- **S2 (should-fix):** "rerank and hybrid weights are options of the store's plugin" names options that no shipped store plugin has. State the boundary without claiming the options exist.

**Landing keyword.** `Fixes #37310` is right only for the head that also carries the amendment part (comment 7221575164). Until #37971 lands and that part follows on this branch, this head must not land under `Fixes`. If it has to land first, change the line to `Part of #37310` and name the half that is left.

**Also, without moving the contract:**
- The PR title still says the type gets a create seed. That is no longer true.
- Verification item 2 in the body points at the wrong file for the KNOWN_UNSEEDED reason.
- The record's nits N1 to N5 are optional.
- Out of scope: `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` also says `knowledge` mounts on `requires` only. That is worth one line in the same pass.

**What holds:**
- Semver: `@objectstack/skills` patch, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- The withdrawn seed, which is byte-identical to main.
- The #17502 premise correction.
- The key table and the retired keys, checked against `knowledge-source.zod.ts`.
- The eval rubrics.
- The ratchet arithmetic, which reproduces 6639 under record 6513306068.

The three fixes add text, so the ratchet row moves again in the delta.

**Next:** fix M1, S1 and S2, then a delta L2 (same reviewer) and a delta L1, then the seat for Tier H.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

**Review round** at 2026-11-28T00:06Z, head `6f2e756f58` (merges `origin/main` at `58be6770ab`, after #38043). This answers the M1, S1 and S2 findings.

**M1: which items mount the service.** The section no longer says that any item mounts the knowledge service. It now says that a shipped item (a `knowledgeSources` entry) mounts the service and its store, and that an app that ships no source and authors its sources at run time needs `requires: ['knowledge']`, or its items are never indexed. This matches `mountedBy: { collection: 'knowledgeSources' }`, which `stackItemCapabilities` reads from the stack, and main's `knowledge-rag.mdx`. The changeset says the same, and the 6609 -> 6639 ratchet comment drops "the item that mounts the service". The platform catalog's Boot cell (generator `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts`) now reads ``on `requires`, or a shipped `knowledgeSources` item`` for a provider that declares `mountedBy`. A test in `platform-catalog.test.ts` pins that cell, with `record-context` as the control that still reads ``on `requires` ``. The skill ref `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is regenerated. Eval case 14 asks for an app that ships no source and authors one at run time, and requires the `requires` line.

**S1: identity.** A source is identified by its package and `name`. `search_knowledge` lists a package's source as `NAMESPACE-NAME` (bare for a source that no package holds). A code registration and an environment item of one name are one slot, and the second is refused. The `name` row now reads "with the package, its identity".

**S2: the closing note.** It no longer says that rerank and hybrid weights are store-plugin options. It now reads: "Rerank and hybrid weighting are no source key, and no shipped store has a setting for either." Evidence: `knowledge-pgvector` and `knowledge-turso` fuse their keyword and vector legs by reciprocal rank fusion with a fixed constant (`export const RRF_K = 60`, `pgvector-adapter.ts:124`, `turso-adapter.ts:95`). Neither plugin's options interface, nor `KnowledgeMemoryPluginOptions`, has a rerank, weight or fusion key. `git grep -i rerank` finds no hit in the three store plugins' sources.

**Token ratchet.** The `objectstack-ai` row moves 6639 -> 6695 (+56, the measured remainder) under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (record 6513306068, letter B). The duplicates paid down first are the intro's restating clause, its separate `search_knowledge` sentence, the "one name is one source" clause and a longer closing note. SKILL.md is 26581 -> 26806 bytes; the priced text is 26779 bytes, and ceil(26779 / 4) = 6695.

**Readings at `6f2e756f58`.**
- Unlocked, 35 commands, each exit 0. They include `check-skills-token-ratchet` (6695/6695), `check:nul-bytes`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:skill-links` and `check:skill-identifier-liveness`.
- `gen:skill-refs`: exit 0.
- overlap-check: `VERDICT overlap exit 1`, from the same #36158-against-main conflict in the ratchet file. `origin/main`, #38032 and #38013 merge cleanly.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:yaml-examples`, the platform-catalog test, the create-seeds test, the MCP contract case and eval case 14. Six queue attempts under slot `o1C-37310-v4` (about 54 minutes) never acquired the verify lock; the last holder was the #37961 `roundB.sh` run, held over 35 minutes. CI on this head is the evidence for these.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6f2e756f5858217701e09b50d2f4c0dba311cedc`

Delta of record 7229853573 (head `4c965f4a5e`, FAIL with M1, S1 and S2 open). Read: the diff between the two heads on the PR's nine files, the net diff against the new merge base `58be6770ab`, the dev note 7230668192, the PR body and title as edited, the 77 check-runs on this head, and the five commits the merge brought in. `Security-touching` stays `yes`: the section still teaches `manage_knowledge_sources`, the save-time admission and egress. No security weakness was found.

S1 (should-fix): closed

S2 (should-fix): closed

### ① Derived judgments

- **Gate verdicts: green.** 77 check-runs: 60 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 2 `cancelled`. The two cancelled runs are `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` started at 00:10:02Z and superseded by the runs started at 00:10:28Z after the PR body edit; both reruns are `success`, as were the first runs at 23:11Z. `Test Core`, `Test UI`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are `success`. The dev's NOT MEASURED list (`check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:yaml-examples`, the platform-catalog test, the create-seeds test, the MCP contract case) is answered by CI on this head. Eval case 14 is not a CI gate; see N6.
- **Accept-set: unchanged. Right.** The only new code is in `packages/spec/scripts` (a generator and its test), which publishes nothing. `metadata-create-seeds.ts` is still byte-identical to `main`.
- **Token ratchet 6639 to 6695: right, the arithmetic reproduces.** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` is 26806 bytes at this head; the stamp line (`  version: "19.0.0-next.1"`) is 27 bytes; 26779 priced bytes, and ceil(26779 / 4) is 6695 (26779 / 4 = 6694.75). The row on `main` at the merge base is still 6609 against a 26462-byte file, so the whole move on this PR is 6609 to 6695 and both steps are written in the comment. The raise path holds for the second step as it did for the first: the delta deletes text in the same file (the intro's "which records of one object are indexed, and which of their fields", the separate `search_knowledge` sentence, the "one name is one source" clause, the longer closing note), the PR body quotes the ruling verbatim with record 6513306068 and letter B, and the row is pinned at the measurement.
